title: This Suzhou Water Lane Still Matches Its 1229 Map | China Travel Expert
description:
Could an 800-year-old map still guide you down a real street today? In Suzhou, it does.

The Song-dynasty "Pingjiang Map," drawn in 1229, charts Pingjiang Road as a main artery of old Suzhou — and the lane still keeps that same river-beside-road plan eight centuries on. The water is a tributary of the Grand Canal that once made it a trading hub, and its teahouses still host Kunqu opera and Suzhou Pingtan storytelling.

🧭 Expert Tip: Come before 8am. The water lane is near-silent, the Pingtan teahouses are just opening, and you beat the tour groups — then cross to the quieter parallel alleys.

一张1229年的《平江图》，今天照样能沿着走——活了八百年的苏州水乡。
